skill.name: Recover/Evade
skill.strategic_description: Player evasively moves/repositions to the right, causing nearby enemies to leave the immediate visible state and revealing the right-side area.

preconditions: Player is within close proximity to at least one enemy.
The right-side area of the screen is currently unoccupied or contains fewer enemies than the immediate center.
Player has not recently executed a 'Recover/Evade' to the right within the last 2 seconds.
steps: Execute a rapid rightward dash or sidestep maneuver to shift player position away from the nearest enemy's attack range.
Maintain the new right-side position for a brief duration (approx. 0.5s) to allow enemy AI pathing logic to register the gap and break line-of-sight.
Observe the immediate visual field to confirm the previous enemy has moved out of the immediate center view or the right-side area is now revealed.
success_criteria: The nearest enemy has successfully left the immediate visible state (center screen) due to the player's lateral movement.
The right-side area of the game environment is now revealed and accessible for further action.
No damage was taken during the evasion maneuver.
abort_criteria: An enemy successfully lands an attack on the player during the movement.
The player collides with a wall or obstacle preventing the rightward movement.
Abort if no progress after expected duration
